topic: Cutting the daily coffee doesn't fix a budget -- the math on why income and big fixed costs matter far more than small habits
title: Your Daily Coffee Isn't Making You Broke
description:
That viral advice to cut your daily latte to save money is missing the point. The math shows that huge costs like housing and transportation have a far bigger impact on your budget than small daily habits.

#personalfinance #budgeting #lattefactor #costofliving #inflation
